loadAndCacheCodeReview.assessment: No concrete correctness bug found in shared load cancellation/deadline or aggregate IndexedDB accounting. The client uses one signal/deadline across negotiation, body read, validation checkpoints, and cache waits; cancellation is rechecked before result publication. IndexedDB writes perform cursor cleanup, LRU eviction, and replacement in one readwrite transaction, so queued deletes roll back with replacement failure or abort. Entry accounting includes UTF-8 bytes for cache key, exact JSON text, and both ETags; cache keys include server and user identity. The catch around cache.put preserves a validated GET on storage/quota errors while allowing abort/deadline to suppress publication. The review report's stated limitations are consistent with the implementation inspected.
